card.name: Words just before a number
card.fires_on: Spaces or small words right before a number is about to appear, such as 'for the next' before '25 years' or 'divide the value by' before a figure. Also digits inside a number range.

modes.label: Duration before a number
modes.description: The gap or word right before a number of years in tariff or guarantee text.
modes.example: guaranteed income from the government for the next<< >>25 years tax free.

modes.label: Dose or lab figures
modes.description: Linking words or digits just before or inside a numeric value in label text.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to output a number word or digit next, such as 'Five' or 'five'.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to give a number, such as a count of years or a lab value.
